# peakhour_rp_firewall_error_page (Resource)

Manages the RP firewall custom error page. Note: the API does not return the configured content, only whether an error page exists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_rp_firewall_error_page" "example" {
  domain  = "example.com"
  content = "<!doctype html><title>Request blocked</title>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.

### Optional

- `content` (String, Sensitive) Custom error page HTML/content to upload. Set to null to clear/disable. Stored in Terraform state (sensitive).

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether a custom error page is configured (computed).
- `id` (String) RP firewall error page identifier (domain/rp_firewall_error_page).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_rp_firewall_error_page.example example.com
```
